weekLabel: Sun Oct 25 cook · Mon Oct 26 – Sun Nov 1
notes: Headcount 4 (Rory, Wendy, Chloe + 1 adult guest through Nov 8; no guest Tuesday). Tue Oct 27 = car dinner after dance + Wendy's bowl; Sat Oct 31 = Halloween night out. Bold flavors (herbs, citrus, spices, sauces), never spicy for Chloe; heat on the side for Rory. dinners.name: Rory's Mild Apple-Ginger Braised Chuck Roast
dinners.desc: Rory's ORIGINAL recipe, exactly, at 1× for the 4 lb chuck already in the fridge: 2 cups bone broth + ½ cup tamari (much less liquid than Oct 11), no sear, miso + tomato paste. Into the 325°F oven FIRST, covered 4 hr.
dinners.side: Broth-yogurt mash + small shaved fennel-apple slaw

recipe.serves: 4 + ~550 g shredded beef with ½ cup juices for Monday's bowls
recipe.time: 15 min prep · 4 hr covered at 325°F · in the oven by 12:45 PM
ingredients: 4 lb (1.8 kg) grass-fed chuck roast (ON HAND: should already be thawing in the fridge since Wed night)
1 large apple, grated (Honeycrisp or Fuji, ~200 g / ~1 cup) (on hand from last week's order)
1 medium yellow onion, diced (~150 g)
4 garlic cloves, minced
1-inch piece fresh ginger, minced or grated (~1 Tbsp / 10 g)
2 Tbsp (42 g) honey
2 Tbsp (30 g) apple cider vinegar
½ cup (120 g) low-sodium soy sauce or tamari
2 cups (480 g) beef bone broth, the ONLY liquid besides the tamari/vinegar. No extra broth. Gelatin: bloom 1½ Tbsp (10 g) in ¼ cup of THIS measured broth.
1 Tbsp (14 g) toasted sesame oil
1 Tbsp (16 g) tomato paste + 1 tsp (6 g) white miso (Rory uses both; whisk the miso into a little of the broth)
Salt (~1¼ tsp kosher) and black pepper (~¾ tsp). No oil, no sear.
Optional: 1 cinnamon stick + 1 star anise for the first 3 hours; garnish of sliced green onion + toasted sesame seeds
steps: 12:15 PM: oven to 325°F, rack low enough for the covered ceramic pot.
Pat the roast dry; season all sides with salt and pepper. No sear (house method): straight into the ceramic pot.
Add the grated apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, tamari, broth (with the bloomed gelatin), sesame oil, tomato paste and miso. Turn the roast to coat. Add cinnamon/star anise if using.
By 12:45: cover tightly and braise 4 hours, undisturbed. Pull the cinnamon/star anise at 3:45.
4:45: it's done when it shreds easily with two forks (~200–205°F inside). If it resists, 20–30 min more.
5:00: shred in the pot and toss through the juices. If the sauce is thin, simmer uncovered on the stove 5–8 min to reduce.
Rory: 180 g beef with juices, 140 g mash, 100 g slaw ≈ 535 cal / 52 g P. Reserve ~550 g beef + ½ cup juices (fridge, 1 container) for Monday.
recipe.scale: His original is written for a 3–4 lb roast, so 4 lb is 1× with no scaling and the liquid stays at his original amounts (2 cups broth + ½ cup tamari).
recipe.leftovers: ~550 g shredded beef + ½ cup juices → fridge for Mon Oct 26 bowls (eat by Wed).

sideRecipes.title: Broth-and-yogurt mashed potatoes
sideRecipes.serves: ~800 g (Rory 140 · Wendy ~120 · guest ~140 · Chloe ~60; rest for lunches)
ingredients: 1 kg Yukon Gold potatoes (on-hand bag) in 1½-in chunks
120 g warm bone broth
100 g Kalona whole-milk yogurt (it's thinner than Greek, so add it last, to taste)
½ tsp kosher salt, ¼ tsp pepper
steps: 4:30: potatoes into a 4-qt pot of cold salted water; bring to a boil, simmer 12–15 min until knife-tender.
Drain, steam-dry 1 min in the pot, mash with the broth, then the yogurt, salt and pepper.

sideRecipes.title: Small shaved fennel-apple slaw
ingredients: ½ fennel bulb (~140 g) cored and shaved paper-thin + a few fronds (on hand)
½ apple (~85 g) in matchsticks
15 g (1 Tbsp) lemon juice, 5 g honey, pinch of salt
steps: Toss the apple with the lemon right away, add the fennel, honey and salt. Serve within 30 min.

sideRecipes.title: Lemon-oregano chicken breasts (Sunday, for Tue wraps/bowl + grown-up lunches)
sideRecipes.serves: 3 lb raw → ~1,020 g cooked: 3 × 200 g lunches + 360 g for Tuesday (+~60 g spare)
ingredients: 3 lb (1.36 kg) organic air-chilled boneless skinless chicken breasts, thick ends pounded to ¾ in
Zest of 1 lemon + 30 g lemon juice
2 g (1 tsp) dried oregano, 4 g (1½ tsp) garlic powder, 2 g (1 tsp) smoked paprika
9 g (1½ tsp) kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon, spices and salt; spray lightly.
Air-fry at 380°F 14–18 min per batch (don't stack), flipping halfway, to 165°F. Rest 5 min, slice.
Portion: 3 containers × 200 g (Mon–Wed lunches, with 120 g rice each) and 1 container of 360 g for Tuesday (fridge).

sideRecipes.title: Chloe's mini beef meatballs + orzo (Sunday, for Tue lunch + freezer)
sideRecipes.serves: ~32 mini meatballs (15 g): 5 for Tue + ~27 frozen for future lunches
ingredients: 1 lb organic grass-fed ground beef (93% lean)
1 OrgaNICK egg
25 g grated parmesan + 1 tsp for the jar
1 tsp (3 g) gelatin bloomed in 2 Tbsp bone broth
½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp garlic powder, ¼ tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp honey (no pepper)
45 g dry orzo (on hand) → ~100 g cooked
¼ cup mild organic marinara (on hand)
steps: Bloom the gelatin 5 min, microwave 10 sec. Whisk with the egg, parmesan, salt, garlic powder, oregano and honey; mix in the beef gently.
Roll ~32 balls (15 g) with wet hands. Air-fry on parchment at 380°F 8–10 min in 2 batches, shaking once, to 160°F.
Cook the orzo 8–9 min in salted water; drain.
Tue jar container: 5 meatballs + 100 g orzo + ¼ cup marinara (fridge). Freeze the rest flat on a plate 1 hr, then bag + label (3 months).

sideRecipes.title: Homemade protein bars, test batch of 6 (Sunday, during the braise)
sideRecipes.serves: 6 bars (~65 g each) · ≈ 200 cal · 20 g P · 9 g C · 10 g F each (estimates)
ingredients: 120 g Noble vanilla beef isolate (5 Creami scoops' worth)
60 g organic creamy almond butter (Sprouts organic, unsalted)
30 g organic almond flour (on hand)
30 g organic maple syrup
20 g organic mini dark chocolate chips (10 g in, 10 g pressed on top)
40–60 g Grassmilk whole milk, added 10 g at a time
2 g vanilla, 1 g (pinch) salt
steps: Line an 8×4-in loaf pan with parchment, overhanging the sides.

Stir the almond butter, maple syrup, vanilla and 40 g milk smooth. Add the isolate, almond flour and salt; mix, then knead by hand. Add milk 10 g at a time only until it holds together like play-dough (beef isolate goes from crumbly to sticky fast).
Fold in 10 g chips. Press firmly and evenly into the pan (use the bottom of a measuring cup), press the other 10 g chips on top.
Chill 1 hr in the fridge (or 30 min in the freezer). Lift out, cut into 6 bars (~65 g each).
Store airtight in the fridge up to 7 days, or wrap and freeze up to 2 months. Rory: note the texture vs Jacob bars so the next batch can be tuned.

dinners.name: Ginger-scallion apple-ginger beef rice bowls
dinners.desc: Sunday's chuck re-crisped in a hot skillet with its own reduced juices, over bone broth rice, with a bright ginger-scallion-lime sauce and smashed cucumbers. Chloe's: beef, rice, plain cucumbers. Chili crisp/hot sauce on the side for Rory.
dinners.side: Smashed cucumber salad (coconut aminos, lime, garlic, sesame seeds)

recipe.time: 20 min, reheat + assemble (all from the fridge)
ingredients: ~550 g shredded apple-ginger chuck + ½ cup juices (fridge, from Sunday)
430 g bone broth rice (fridge, from Sunday) + 2 Tbsp bone broth

Ginger-scallion sauce (~150 g, made Sunday, fridge): 1½ bunches green onions (~90 g) sliced very thin, 20 g fresh ginger grated, 1 garlic clove grated, 3 g (½ tsp) kosher salt, 15 g lime juice, 5 g coconut aminos, 5 g (1 tsp) toasted sesame oil. Pour 30 g just-boiled bone broth over it to bloom (instead of the usual ¼ cup hot oil).

Smashed cucumber salad (~250 g; Rory 100 · Wendy ~80 · Chloe ~40 plain): 1 English cucumber, smashed and cut in 1-in pieces, salted ½ tsp 10 min and drained; 10 g coconut aminos, 10 g lime juice, 3 g honey, 1 small garlic clove grated, 2 g toasted sesame seeds. Make Monday.
Rory only: chili crisp or hot sauce on the side; optional fried OrgaNICK egg on top
steps: Smash the cucumber (flat of a knife), salt, drain 10 min, dress.

12-in stainless skillet over medium-high, spray. Add the beef in an even layer with half the juices; leave it alone 3–4 min until the edges crisp, then toss and add the rest of the juices; 2 min more until sticky and 165°F.
Rice: covered bowl with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min (or a covered pan, 5 min) to steaming.
Bowls: rice, beef, 1 Tbsp ginger-scallion sauce, cucumbers on the side. Chloe: beef + rice + plain cucumber.
Rory: 150 g beef, 120 g rice, 100 g cucumbers, 15 g sauce ≈ 515 cal / 47 g P.

dinners.name: Car dinner after dance (Rory + Chloe) · Wendy's bowl at home
dinners.desc: Rory and Chloe: toasted lemon-oregano chicken & hummus wraps, wrapped in parchment and foil to eat by hand in the car. Wendy at home: lemon-oregano chicken bowl with rice, hummus, cucumber-tomato and lemon. No guests Tuesday.
dinners.side: Cucumber + red bell pepper spears (+ apple slices for Chloe), packed in a steel container

recipe.serves: 3: Rory + Chloe in the car, Wendy at home
recipe.time: 15 min before you leave to pick up Chloe
ingredients: 360 g lemon-oregano chicken breast, sliced (fridge, from Sunday): Rory 150 g, Chloe 60 g, Wendy 150 g
3 small organic whole-wheat tortillas (Oladito, ~45 g each): 2 for Rory, 1 for Chloe
Hummus (Cedar's organic): 30 g Rory, 15 g Chloe, 30 g Wendy
½ English cucumber thin-sliced for the wraps; squeeze of lemon; pinch of dried oregano
Car sides: rest of the cucumber + 1 red bell pepper in spears (~250 g; Rory 150 g, Chloe ~100 g), 1 small apple sliced for Chloe
Wendy's bowl: 150 g chicken, 120 g bone broth rice (fridge), 30 g hummus, 80 g cucumber + 2 cherry-size tomato pieces or extra pepper, lemon wedge, oregano
Rory only: hot sauce packet on the side. Packing: parchment, foil, insulated bag, 2 napkins
steps: Warm the chicken in a stainless skillet with 1 Tbsp broth 3–4 min to 165°F.
Warm the tortillas 20 sec per side in a dry skillet. Spread hummus, add chicken, cucumber, lemon and oregano. Fold the sides and roll tight.
Toast seam-side down in the dry skillet 1–2 min per side until sealed. Wrap in parchment, then foil. Eat within 2 hours.
Thermal-jar option for Chloe: 60 g chicken + 40 g rice heated to 165°F with 1 Tbsp broth in her preheated 12 oz jar.
Wendy: microwave the chicken + rice covered 2–2½ min to 165°F, then add hummus, cucumber, lemon.
Rory: 2 wraps (90 g tortillas, 150 g chicken, 30 g hummus) + 150 g spears ≈ 620 cal / 59 g P.

dinners.name: Peruvian garlic-cumin chicken thighs + aji verde
dinners.desc: Rotation winner, exactly as Rory liked it Oct 18: all 4 lb thighs on ONE pan so the juice pools, then the pan juices reduced into a glaze; potatoes split across TWO pans. Jalapeño only in Rory's aji verde.
dinners.side: Smoky oven potatoes (2 pans) + lime green beans (small)

recipe.serves: 4 + ~650 g cooked chicken for Thu/Fri lunches and Chloe's Thu lunch
recipe.time: 10 min marinade (Wed AM or Tue night) · ~40 min at 425°F
ingredients: 4 lb (1.8 kg) organic air-chilled boneless skinless chicken thighs (frozen on delivery; fridge Mon night)

Marinade (Wed morning, ≥2 hr; or Tue night): 25 g garlic (8 cloves) grated, 45 g lime juice (3 limes) + zest of 1, 30 g coconut aminos, 8 g (1 Tbsp) smoked paprika, 6 g (2 tsp) ground cumin, 2 g (1 tsp) dried oregano, 9 g (1½ tsp) kosher salt, 2 g (¾ tsp) pepper, 10 g honey. No oil.

Aji verde (~250 g, make while the oven heats): 170 g Kalona whole-milk yogurt, 30 g cilantro (stems ok), 15 g grated parmesan, 15 g lime juice, 1 garlic clove, 3 g salt; blend. Kalona is thinner than Greek, so it's a pourable sauce. Rory's jar: blend ⅓ of it with ½–1 jalapeño (on hand from last week).
700 g Yukon potatoes in 1-in chunks, split across TWO parchment-lined quarter- or half-sheet pans (350 g each), spray, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ¼ tsp cumin
270 g green beans (Rory 120 · Wendy ~100 · Chloe ~50), spray, ⅓ tsp salt, lime zest
steps: 4:30 PM: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle. Chicken: ONE parchment-lined, sprayed rimmed half-sheet pan; lay all 4 lb flat, snug, scraping the marinade on top.
4:40: chicken in on the upper-middle rack; both potato pans side by side (or stacked racks) below. Shake the potatoes at 15 and 25 min.
Bake the chicken 30–35 min to 175°F. Potatoes 30–35 min until browned and crisp.
5:10: green beans in the air fryer at 400°F 7–8 min, then lime zest.
5:15: move the chicken to a board. Pour the pooled pan juices into a small skillet and boil 3–4 min until syrupy; brush/toss it over the chicken (this is the glaze Rory loved).
Set aside for Thu: 70 g chicken + ~90 g potatoes for Chloe's lunch; 3 × 200 g chicken for grown-up lunches (fridge).
Rory: 180 g chicken, 150 g potatoes, 120 g green beans, 40 g aji verde ≈ 555 cal / 52 g P.

dinners.name: Chermoula wild salmon
dinners.desc: Wild sockeye brushed with chermoula (parsley, cilantro, lemon, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika), roasted hot. Herby and bright, not spicy; Aleppo/hot sauce on the side for Rory.
dinners.side: Bone broth rice + honey-cumin roasted carrots

recipe.serves: 4 (raw portions: Rory ~210 g, Wendy ~180 g, guest ~200 g, Chloe ~85 g)
ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) wild-caught sockeye, 4 portions (frozen on delivery; fridge Wed night)

Chermoula (~120 g): 30 g parsley + 30 g cilantro (leaves + tender stems), 3 garlic cloves, 30 g lemon juice + zest of 1 lemon, 15 g (1 Tbsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 30 g bone broth or water, 4 g (2 tsp) ground cumin, 3 g (1 tsp) smoked paprika, 3 g (½ tsp) kosher salt, 3 g honey. Blitz or chop fine.
Honey-cumin carrots (~380 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy ~120 · Chloe ~50): 1 lb (454 g) carrots in 3-in sticks, spray, 10 g honey, ½ tsp cumin, ⅓ tsp salt, squeeze of lemon
450 g bone broth rice (frozen Sunday; fridge Wed night) + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory only: Aleppo or hot sauce on the side
steps: 5:00: oven to 425°F, 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans. Carrots on pan B with spray, cumin, salt; in first (5:05) on the lower rack, 25 min, tossing once; honey + lemon for the last 5 min.
Pat the salmon dry, set skin-side down on pan A (sprayed), salt lightly, spread on half the chermoula.
5:15: salmon in on the upper rack, 10–12 min, to 145°F / flakes easily (pull Chloe's piece 2–3 min early).
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 3 min to steaming.
Spoon a little of the remaining chermoula over each plate (Chloe's optional).
Rory: 180 g cooked salmon, 120 g rice, 150 g carrots, 15 g chermoula ≈ 585 cal / 54 g P.

dinners.name: Steak night: seared grass-fed sirloin + chimichurri
dinners.desc: Rotation winner ('absolute banger', Oct 16): hard-seared grass-fed top sirloin, bright low-oil chimichurri (red pepper flakes only in Rory's), oven-roasted Yukon potatoes at 425°F (oven, not air fryer), lemon-garlic green beans.
dinners.side: Oven-roasted Yukon potatoes + lemon-garlic green beans

recipe.serves: 4 (raw: Rory ~225 g, Wendy ~200 g, guest ~225 g, Chloe ~100 g)
ingredients: 2 lb (907 g) grass-fed top sirloin, ~1 in thick (frozen on delivery; fridge Thu night)
1¼ tsp kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, avocado-oil spray

Chimichurri (~150 g): 40 g flat-leaf parsley chopped fine, 3 garlic cloves minced, 1 tsp dried oregano, 30 g red wine vinegar, 15 g lemon juice, 27 g (2 Tbsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 30 g water, ½ tsp kosher salt, ¼ tsp pepper. Rory's portion: + ¼–½ tsp red pepper flakes. Make Thu night or Fri; rest 15 min+.
Potatoes: 800 g Yukon Golds in 1-in chunks, split across 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans, spray, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika
Lemon-garlic green beans (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy ~100 · Chloe ~50): 340 g green beans trimmed, ½ cup (120 g) bone broth, 3 garlic cloves sliced, zest of 1 lemon + 1 tsp juice, ⅓ tsp salt
steps: 4:45: salt the steaks; leave on the counter 30–40 min. Oven to 425°F.
5:00: potatoes in (both pans, upper-middle + lower-middle), 30–35 min, shaking at 15 and 25 min, swapping racks once, until deep golden.
5:20: green beans in a wide lidded pan with the broth and garlic: covered 6–7 min, uncover and cook off the liquid 1–2 min; zest, juice, salt.

5:20: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high 3 min, spray, sear the steaks 4–5 min per side (2 at a time) to 130–135°F for medium-rare (USDA: 145°F). Chloe's piece to 145°F if she prefers. Rest 5–10 min, slice against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced steak (Rory's from his spicy jar).
Rory: 170 g cooked sirloin, 180 g potatoes, 150 g green beans, 25 g chimichurri ≈ 585 cal / 59 g P.

dinners.name: Halloween · night out
dinners.desc: Saturday is our standing night out (Halloween!). No prep, nothing bought for it.

dinners.name: Next Sunday's batch cook (planned next Thursday)
dinners.desc: Sun Nov 1's cook feeds the week of Nov 2 and gets planned (and shopped) with next Thursday's list. Nothing for it is in this order.

chloeLunches.items: 4 Bell & Evans organic nuggets + ~100 g potato wedges (made Sunday), 2 Tbsp honey mustard in a steel dip cup, ½ mango in chunks
chloeLunches.how: Nuggets are sold uncooked: air-fry from frozen at 400°F 10–12 min, shaking at 6 min, to 170°F; add the wedges for the last 4 min. Pack hot in the preheated jar; mango + dip in the bento with an ice pack.

chloeLunches.items: 5 mini grass-fed beef meatballs + 100 g orzo in ¼ cup mild marinara, 1 tsp parmesan (jar made Sunday, fridge); 1 small apple sliced + 1 kiwi
chloeLunches.how: Heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 6–8 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar; parmesan on top. Fruit in the bento.

chloeLunches.items: Mild veggie egg fried rice: 120 g bone broth rice (Sunday) + 2 OrgaNICK eggs + 40 g frozen peas + 20 g grated carrot, 1 tsp coconut aminos, ½ tsp sesame oil; mandarin + ½ kiwi
chloeLunches.how: Spray a 10-in nonstick/steel pan, scramble the eggs soft and set aside; add the rice, peas, carrot and 1 Tbsp broth, 3–4 min until steaming; fold in the eggs, aminos and sesame oil (165°F). Pack hot.

chloeLunches.items: 70 g Peruvian chicken (from Wed dinner, no aji verde) + ~90 g oven potatoes, 2 Tbsp Kalona yogurt-lime dip, ½ mango + a few strawberries
chloeLunches.how: Reheat chicken + potatoes covered with 1 Tbsp broth 2 min (or skillet 4–5 min) to 165°F. Pack hot; dip and fruit in the bento.

breakfasts: Yogurt bowls: 170 g Kalona grass-fed whole-milk yogurt + 75 g berries + ½ kiwi, honey optional, no granola. (Kalona is regular, not Greek: ~110 cal / 6 g P per 170 g, so pair it with eggs.)
Eggs: 2 dozen OrgaNICK (fried or scrambled with spray, 2–3 min); 2 go into Chloe's Wed fried rice and 1 into her meatballs. No egg bites this week.
Snacks: 6 homemade protein bars (Sunday test batch, ~200 cal / 20 g P each, fridge) instead of Jacob bars.
lunches: Grown-up lunches: Mon–Wed 3 × (200 g lemon-oregano chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + spears); Thu–Fri 3 × 200 g Peruvian chicken (from Wed) + leftover potatoes/aji verde; extra mash and beef as they come.

creami.name: Honey vanilla ×2
creami.desc: (per pint) 200 g organic low-fat cottage cheese, 60 g Kalona whole-milk yogurt, 100 g Grassmilk whole milk, 40 g cold water, 14 g honey, 2 g vanilla, 0.5 g salt, 24 g Noble vanilla beef isolate. ≈ 400 cal · 48 g P per pint; ⅓ ≈ 133 cal · 16 g P.

creami.name: Chocolate ×1 (Rory's 'fire' pint)
creami.desc: 230 g cottage cheese, 100 g milk, 60 g water, 12 g organic cocoa, 12 g maple syrup, 1 g vanilla, 0.5 g salt, 24 g Noble. Optional 4 g dark chocolate chips mix-in. ≈ 396 cal · 51 g P; ⅓ ≈ 132 cal · 17 g P. Unchanged.

creami.name: Cookies 'n cream ×1 (new fun pint)
creami.desc: Base: 220 g cottage cheese, 80 g milk, 60 g water, 5 g honey, 3 g vanilla, 0.5 g salt, 24 g Noble. Cocoa 'cookie' crumble: 8 g almond flour + 4 g cocoa + 4 g maple syrup + pinch of salt, pressed 3 mm thin on parchment, baked beside the roast at 325°F 10–12 min, cooled, crumbled and frozen. Spin Lite Ice Cream, then MIX-IN the crumble. ≈ 405 cal · 51 g P; ⅓ ≈ 135 cal · 17 g P.

creami.name: Pistachio ×1 (Wendy)
creami.desc: 220 g cottage cheese, 110 g milk, 40 g water, 32 g pistachio butter (ON HAND), 8 g honey, 1 g vanilla, 0.5 g salt, 24 g Noble. ≈ 550 cal · 54 g P; ⅓ ≈ 183 cal · 18 g P (20 g butter → ~430/pint if she wants it lighter).

creami.name: Mango ×1 (pure mango, no banana)
creami.desc: 300 g ripe mango chunks (~1½ mangoes), 120 g cottage cheese, 40 g milk, 5 g lime juice, 24 g Noble, no honey. Spin Lite Ice Cream (Sorbet for icier). ≈ 392 cal · 37 g P; ⅓ ≈ 131 cal · 12 g P.

creami.name: Notes
creami.desc: Make Sunday, freeze level 24 h. Blend each base 30–45 s until smooth, fill to the max line. Re-spin with 15–30 g milk if crumbly. Totals for 6 pints: cottage cheese ~1,190 g · milk ~530 g · Kalona 120 g · Noble 144 g (+120 g for the protein bars = 264 g) · cocoa 16 g · maple 16 g · almond flour 8 g · mango 300 g. Macros are estimates (Noble 24 g counted as ~90 cal / 20 g P).

prep.title: Check the chuck is thawing
prep.step: If the 4 lb chuck isn't already in the fridge (it was due to move Wed night), move it today so it's thawed by Sunday.

prep.title: Oven to 325°F + roast prep
prep.step: Oven to 325°F (rack low for the covered ceramic pot). Grate the apple (200 g), dice the onion (150 g), mince 4 garlic cloves, grate 10 g ginger. Bloom 10 g gelatin in ¼ cup of the 2 cups broth; whisk the miso into a splash of broth.

prep.title: ROAST IN FIRST
prep.step: Season the chuck (salt + pepper, no sear), into the ceramic pot with the apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, tamari, broth, sesame oil, tomato paste and miso (+ cinnamon/star anise). Cover tightly; in the oven by 12:45. Done ~4:45.

prep.title: Bone broth rice
prep.step: Rinse 420 g jasmine; 4-qt saucepan with 720 g bone broth + ¾ tsp salt. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min → ~1,530 g. Spread on a sheet pan to cool (fridge within 1 hr).

prep.title: Lunch chicken (air fryer)
prep.step: Season 3 lb breasts lemon-oregano; air-fry 380°F 14–18 min per batch (batches at ~1:00, 1:20, 1:40) to 165°F. Rest, slice.

prep.title: Creami bases (6 pints)
prep.step: Blend and fill: 2 honey vanilla, 1 chocolate, 1 cookies 'n cream base, 1 pistachio, 1 mango. Lids on, freeze level. Mix the cocoa crumble and press it thin on a small parchment-lined tray. ~35 min.

prep.title: Chloe's meatballs + orzo
prep.step: Mix and roll ~32 mini meatballs; air-fry after the chicken (380°F, 8–10 min × 2 batches, ~2:00–2:20). Cook 45 g orzo 8–9 min.

prep.title: Protein bars (test batch of 6)
prep.step: Mix, press into a lined 8×4 loaf pan, chill 1 hr. At the same time, slide the cocoa-crumble tray in next to the roast (325°F, 10–12 min); cool, crumble, freeze for the cookies 'n cream pint.

prep.title: Chloe's wedges + Monday sauce
prep.step: 1 Yukon potato (~180 g) in 8 wedges, spray, ¼ tsp salt, air fryer 400°F 15 min. Meanwhile make the ginger-scallion sauce (broth-bloomed) and 2 Tbsp honey mustard (1 Tbsp honey + 1 Tbsp Dijon).

prep.title: Portion + label
prep.step: FRIDGE: Mon rice 430 g · Wendy Tue 120 g · Chloe Wed 120 g · 3 lunches × (200 g chicken + 120 g rice) · Tue chicken 360 g · Chloe Tue jar (5 meatballs + 100 g orzo + ¼ cup marinara) · wedges · sauces. FREEZER: Thu rice 450 g · ~27 extra meatballs. Label dish / day / grams / 'cooked 10/25'.

prep.title: Cut bars, fruit, clean up
prep.step: Cut the bars into 6 (fridge). Wash/cut fruit (mango, kiwi, strawberries). Everything cooked is in the fridge or freezer by ~3:30. Clean up.

prep.title: Pull the spices
prep.step: Remove the cinnamon stick and star anise from the roast (if used). Re-cover.

prep.title: Mash on
prep.step: 1 kg Yukons into cold salted water; boil, simmer 12–15 min. Drain, steam-dry, mash with 120 g broth + 100 g Kalona yogurt.

prep.title: Roast check
prep.step: Shreds easily with two forks (~200–205°F)? Out. If not, 20–30 min more.

prep.title: Shred + reduce
prep.step: Shred in the pot, toss through the juices; reduce uncovered on the stove 5–8 min if thin.

prep.title: Slaw + plate
prep.step: Shave the fennel-apple slaw. Dinner ~5:30. After dinner: ~550 g beef + ½ cup juices → fridge for Monday.

prep.title: Thaw + marinate schedule
prep.step: Sat Oct 24 delivery: FREEZE the thighs, salmon and sirloin on arrival. Mon night: thighs → fridge. Wed AM (or Tue night): marinate the thighs. Wed night: salmon + Thu rice → fridge. Thu night: sirloin → fridge, make the chimichurri.

prepNote: Sun Oct 25: the chuck goes into the 325°F oven FIRST (by 12:45); batch prep 12:45–3:30 while it braises (rice, lunch chicken, 6 Creami, Chloe's meatballs, 6 protein bars, wedges, sauces); dinner ~5:30.

lunchIntro: Each morning: fill the 12 oz thermal jar with boiling water for 5–10 min, then dump it. Heat the hot food to 165°F (steaming), pack it into the warmed jar, and close it. Cold food goes in the steel bento with an ice pack, and everything goes in the insulated bag.
prepIntro: Times assume a 12:15 PM start and dinner around 5:30 PM. About 3¼ hours hands-on, all while the roast braises. Tuesday is the car dinner (no cooking beyond 15 min), Saturday is Halloween night out, and Thu/Fri dinners are cooked fresh.
prepSafety: Chicken 165°F (thighs best at 175°F); ground beef 160°F; salmon 145°F; reheated leftovers 165°F. Bell & Evans nuggets are sold uncooked: cook to 170°F.
Cool fast: spread rice on a sheet pan; everything into the fridge within 1–2 hours (rice within 1 hour).
Fridge = eaten Mon–Wed. Freezer = Thu onward (Thu rice, extra meatballs). Thu/Fri dinners are cooked fresh from proteins frozen on delivery.
Reheat each portion only once. Label every container with dish, day, grams and 'cooked 10/25'.
prepThaw: Sat Oct 24 (delivery): freeze the thighs, salmon and sirloin right away.
Mon night: 4 lb thighs → fridge (for Wed).
Wed morning (or Tue night): marinate the thighs.
Wed night: salmon + Thu rice (450 g) → fridge.
Thu night: sirloin → fridge; make the chimichurri.
